artworks.title: Un moment ... votre vache n'a pas eu l'epizoodie? ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two men and a cow in a cartoon style. Both men are shown standing facing each other. The man on the left has a bald head with curly hair around it and a full beard. He is pulling his shirt collar with one hand and appears surprised or apprehensive. He is wearing a shirt and trousers. The other man has long, dark hair and sharp facial features. He is leaning forward, speaking to the first man with a slightly bent posture. He is dressed in a dark suit and holding a thin stick or straw. A cow with horns is standing behind them, facing forward. The background is plain with shading, suggesting an indoor space. French text is included at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Renouvelé des petites Danaides
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures pouring liquid into a barrel labeled "TRAITÉS de 1815 FAUX EQUILIBRE EUROPÉEN." The illustration features figures with exaggerated facial expressions and attire. The figures are trying to fill a leaking barrel against a simple background. The label on the barrel references the "Treaties of 1815" and "False European Balance." The drawing has a playful yet critical tone, with dynamic poses and expressive faces. The style is monochromatic with detailed line work and shading, typical of political cartoons from the 19th century.

artworks.title: Abusant de la liberté
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is an illustration of two people in a struggle beside a carriage with a distressed person inside. The scene captures a moment of conflict as one individual attempts to restrain another. The carriage is drawn with loose lines, suggesting motion, and the background shows urban architecture. The style features exaggerated expressions and dynamic poses, typical of a caricature, conveying a satirical tone.

artworks.title: L'Arbre de Noël des Grands Enfants
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a Christmas tree decorated with various items, surrounded by a group of people. The tree is ornately decorated with musical instruments, money, and other objects. Figures at the base of the tree are reaching towards it excitedly. The style is satirical and caricatured, with exaggerated expressions and animated postures. The caption at the bottom reads "l'Arbre de Noël des Grands Enfants." The illustration features strong lines and shading, typical of 19th-century caricature art.

artworks.title: Allons pour année papa mars ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: In the image, two figures are depicted in full-body views in a classical style. On the left, a person is leaning forward, holding a long spear or staff, with their head slightly bowed down. This figure is dressed in a tunic or ancient-style garment and is wearing a helmet with a prominent crest. On the right, there is a cherubic figure with wings, commonly recognized as depicting Cupid, standing in a relaxed pose with one hand on the hip and the other draped with a cloth. The cherub has curly hair adorned with what appears to be a laurel wreath. Both figures appear to be surrounded by a garden setting, with bushes and a visible tree branch on the left side. In the foreground, a watering can is placed near the cherubic figure, along with other gardening tools. The background consists of a simple, open landscape, providing little detail beyond a suggestion of a natural environment. The image is bordered with a line, and some text is visible below the scene.

artworks.title: Vous croyez peut être que c'est un spectateur...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is an image showing a theater scene with a person watching from the rows of seats. It portrays a theater interior with a dramatic scene unfolding on stage, featuring actors in period costumes and an elaborate backdrop. The audience seating is mostly empty, with one figure seated and observing the performance. The stage is busy with movement, with theatrical effects like smoke or fabric in the background. The drawing is done in monochrome, using shades of gray for depth and focus to highlight the grandeur of the setting and the solitude of the observer.

artworks.title: Faisons semblant de dormier ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men seated within what appears to be the interior of a lavishly decorated space, likely a train or a private chamber, with a upholstered, patterned wall behind them. Both men are depicted from the waist up and are leaning to the side as if asleep, with their heads tilted downward. The man on the left has thinning hair on top and more pronounced hair at the sides, and is wearing a dark suit jacket, waistcoat, and shirt. The man on the right also has receding hair and a large moustache, and is dressed similarly in a suit with a waistcoat and shirt. There is a hat placed on the ledge above both men. The intricate pattern on the seat back behind them, as well as the textured shading, suggests luxury and comfort.

artworks.title: La partie de saute-mouton
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an armored soldier and a draped figure in an animated scene. The drawing uses strong lines to illustrate the soldier wearing a helmet with a pointed spike on top, stretching his arm and stepping forward in motion. Opposite him is a draped figure, bent over with a pipe in their mouth. The ground beneath them suggests they are on a flat surface. The drawing may be satirical, playing on themes of military and civilian interaction, as indicated by the text below the image, which suggests a game of leapfrog. The drawing is done in a caricature style.

artworks.title: Bonne occasion pour vérifier ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is an image of a speaker at a podium addressing an audience. The drawing shows a central figure with exaggerated features speaking from a podium. The crowd in the foreground and background is engaged, with individuals gesturing and leaning towards the speaker. The artwork features exaggerated expressions and energetic lines, giving a sense of movement and dynamism. The style is reminiscent of Honoré Daumier, known for satirical social commentary and depictions of 19th-century life. The drawing conveys drama and intensity, highlighting the power of public speaking.

artworks.title: Pas trop écourté, s'il vous  plait
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures. One figure is holding fabric labeled "LIBERTE" while the other, labeled "CONSTITUTION," appears to be adjusting it. The standing figure holds a garment that reads "LIBERTE," while the seated figure seems to be adjusting its length, with the inscription "CONSTITUTION" near its feet. The scene is set on a minimal background, emphasizing the interaction between the figures. The drawing employs strong lines and a monochrome palette.

artworks.title: Est-ce que vous allez ouvrir la porte de la cage ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large birdcage with a bird inside, placed on a pedestal. Two figures are outside the cage: a jester-like character holding a feather and a woman holding a paint bucket, with "RUE DE POITIERS" on her clothing. Their expressions and postures suggest a humorous or critical tone. The drawing is detailed with cross-hatching and meticulous line work, resembling illustrations from the 19th century. There is a French caption at the bottom that translates, "- Are you going to open the cage door? - For example .... I am going to repaint it." The style is reminiscent of Honoré Daumier.

artworks.title: Projet ... Pour désarmer les ennemis de ... Voltaire
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a statue of an elderly figure seated on a throne. The figure's features are exaggerated, with a long face, pronounced cheekbones, and a large, pointed hat. The figure wears dark robes with detailed wrinkles on the face, conveying a sense of age and wisdom. The base of the statue is inscribed with the word "VOLTAIRE." The drawing uses strong lines and contrasts to create depth, with a style reminiscent of 19th-century caricature work, emphasizing satirical elements. The drawing presents a humorous or critical take on the veneration of Enlightenment figures through statuary.

artworks.title: L'idéal de certains journaux
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a soldier and a woman labeled "Assemblée Nationale." The soldier has exaggerated facial features and is wearing a uniform with a spiked helmet, while the woman is draped in cloth, gesturing as if dancing, with a skull perched on her head. Their interlocked arms suggest a partnership. The image conveys a satirical tone, with the title underneath: "L'idéal de certains journaux" (The ideal of certain newspapers). The style is consistent with that of Honoré Daumier, known for his caricatures highlighting societal and political commentary.

artworks.title: Décret de la commune
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a hand surrounded by papers and coins. The hand is reaching for coins amidst a chaotic array of papers scattered around a bowl. Each paper is inscribed with the words "Quitance de Loyer" and other phrases. The scene conveys a sense of financial turmoil or obligation. The drawing employs a monochromatic color palette, relying on shading and texture to create depth and detail. The composition is busy and somewhat chaotic.

artworks.title: La Tristesse de Rouher
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a drawn caricature of a man standing with his hands on his hips. He has exaggerated facial features, wearing a dark suit with a white shirt. Beside him is a glass display case with a bird-like figure statue on a pedestal. The background has a lightly textured, monochrome style.

artworks.title: Requiescat in pace!
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This image depicts a draped coffin with candles surrounding it. The coffin is labeled "Affaires Etrangeres" and there is the phrase "Pouvoir Temporel" above it. Dripping lines are shown above the coffin. Tall candles with smoke coming from them are placed on either side. At the bottom of the image, the words "Requiescat in Pace!" are featured.

artworks.title: La république de Milo...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The sculpture is a classical-style figure resembling ancient Greek statues like the Venus de Milo. The figure is draped in flowing garments, with detailed fabric folds and a face turned slightly to the side. The monochromatic sculpture is in shades of gray and black, giving the impression of a pencil sketch or engraving. It is on a pedestal, surrounded by onlookers sketched in a smaller, condensed manner. The crowd includes detailed faces, hats, and coats, suggesting a period style. The setting appears to be a public exhibition or gallery display.

artworks.title: Une assembleé modèle ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three exaggerated, grotesque figures with distorted, comically grotesque faces and elongated, stretched bodies entangled in a chaotic scene. The background contains loosely sketched outlines of further abstract figures or faces, suggesting a crowd or assembly. The figures appear to be struggling against each other, with a sense of movement and agitation conveyed through the lines and shading. The title at the bottom reads "UNE ASSEMBLÉE MODÈLE ou L'UNION FAIT LA FORCE."

artworks.title: Merci, je sors d'en prendre
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a reclining figure and three other figures holding large bottles. The figure on the left is seated on a chair, draped in flowing garments. The three figures standing on the right side are presenting large bottles labeled with text to the reclining figure. The scene is captured with a focus on the interaction and the contrast between the postures of the figures. The illustration is in black and white, crafted with detailed line work, shading, and an emphasis on facial expressions and body language to communicate the narrative.

artworks.title: Mon bon ami, faites-moi le plaisir de signer ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This image depicts two men conversing. One man is tall and thin, wearing a wide-brimmed hat and holding a document in one hand. The other man is shorter and older, hunched over, wearing a long coat, and holding onto a hat. The drawing is in a caricature style, reminiscent of 19th-century satirical cartoons, with text below the image indicating a conversation about signing a petition against mandatory education.

artworks.title: Pas étonnant que ce soit long ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an open book with scribbled text. The image depicts a large, open book on a desk, with the pages scribbled with black lines. At the top of the pages, the words "COMMISSION DE NOUET" are written. The drawing includes a hand holding a quill pen, poised to write on the book’s pages. The drawing features strong, bold lines with minimal shading, capturing a simplistic yet expressive scene.

artworks.title: Merci, ma vieille, trop décrépite! ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two caricatures of elderly figures facing each other. The figure on the left is an elderly man standing upright with his hands behind his back. He has exaggerated facial features, with a prominent nose and chin, and short hair. He is dressed in a loose-fitting shirt and pants. The figure on the right is an elderly woman who appears to be leaning slightly forward while gesturing with her hand. She has a pointed nose, a crown on her head, and is dressed in a flowing gown that reads "Monarchie." Her gown and hair are covered by a long veil. She holds a book-like object in her hand. The background is plain with a faintly sketched floor, suggesting an indoor setting.

artworks.title: Et ces deux laids débris se désolaient entre eux
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals standing side by side. The person on the left uses a crutch and wears dark clothing with a head covering. The person on the right holds a cane and wears dark, flowing clothing. Both individuals lean slightly forward. The background is plain with a light texture. A border with text is at the top and a caption is underneath the figures.

artworks.title: Etrennes de 1856 ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in historic attire standing beside each other. One person, a man, has distinctive facial features and wears a dark suit with a hat in hand. The other person, a woman, has her hair styled up and wears a long dress. A small animal with rough fur walks in front of them. The background consists of vertical lines indicating a wall or curtain.
